install: export PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH && npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox && bash scripts/bootstrap.sh medusa
start: sudo service docker start && (grep -qE '^127\.0\.0\.1[[:space:]]+p1\.lvh\.me$' /etc/hosts || echo '127.0.0.1 p1.lvh.me' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null)
